title: Complete architecture review context and evidence contract
correctionCommitMessage: fix: preserve complete architecture review context
rootCause: The normal Architecture Reviewer received the full typed approved Brief and accepted PlanningPackage, but its canonical evidence allowlist exposed only a subset of Brief fields, so material obligations could be rejected as invented evidence. Its idempotency identity also omitted bounded project constraints and the fixed policy. Factory self-review used a separate source evidence pack without an explicit documentation-only boundary.

reviewStage.factorySelfReview: Phase 5/6 bounded Factory repository evidence-pack review

affectedConsumer: ArchitectureReviewService canonical input precheck, review identity, provider context, and normalizeResult evidence validation

contextBefore.normal: approvedBrief and acceptedPlanningPackage were typed, project/version/checksum checked, and sent to the provider; canonicalArchitectureEvidence allowed only 8 named Brief fields plus Planning fields, omitting content, SEO, localization, user roles, acceptance criteria, exclusions, and unresolved-item references.
contextBefore.selfReview: Factory self-review had bounded repository evidence but no project-specific Brief or PlanningPackage, without a visible documentation-only limitation in the Architecture Reviewer contract.
contextBefore.identity: projectId, projectVersion, Brief checksum, Planning checksum, selected skill identity, policy version, and prompt version were hashed; relevantProjectConstraints and factoryArchitecturePolicy were not.

contextAfter.normal: All material approved Brief fields, identity/approval metadata, accepted Planning identity/acceptance/architecture references, and dynamic page/flow/form/entity/decision references are canonical evidence; invented references remain rejected.
contextAfter.selfReview: The architecture contract explicitly states that Factory self-review is documentation-only and cannot establish project-specific requirement traceability or substitute for normal ArchitectureReviewInput.
contextAfter.identity: The semantic review identity now includes factoryArchitecturePolicy and relevantProjectConstraints in addition to existing project/artifact/checksum/skill/prompt identity.

excludedInputs: admin reports outside the evidence pack
projectIdentityBinding: ArchitectureReviewInput and deterministic prechecks require the Brief and PlanningPackage projectId and projectVersion to equal the requested project/version; the reviewer result preserves both identity fields.
artifactContentIdentity: Approved Brief and accepted PlanningPackage checksums remain required and participate in review identity; the fixed policy and bounded constraints now also participate.
contextIdentity: checksumPersistedDocument({ projectId, projectVersion, approvedBriefChecksum, acceptedPlanningChecksum, factoryArchitecturePolicy, relevantProjectConstraints, skillContextChecksum, policyVersion, promptVersion })

currentnessBehavior.relevantChange: A changed bounded project constraint causes idempotency conflict and prevents reuse of the prior review.
currentnessBehavior.irrelevantChange: An operational expectedRowVersion change reuses the same semantic result.
currentnessBehavior.wrongProjectOrVersion: Deterministic prechecks reject mixed or stale canonical artifacts before provider work.
currentnessBehavior.historicalRecords: Prior review records remain immutable; new semantic identity requires a new invocation.

canonicalBudgetPriority: Typed canonical Brief/Planning evidence is authoritative and remains ahead of supplemental procedural skills; no global budget was increased.
promptContractBefore: The provider received typed input, but the service's evidence allowlist did not represent every material Brief obligation; Factory self-review's absence of project artifacts was not explicitly distinguished in the architecture documentation.
promptContractAfter: The provider receives the same bounded typed normal-review input, with complete canonical evidence references and identity-bound constraints; skills remain supplemental procedures. Factory self-review is explicitly documentation-only.
deterministicPrechecks: semantic context identity includes policy and constraints

evidencePackBehavior.before: Material Brief evidence references were absent from the allowlist and provider output citing them was rejected as invented.
evidencePackBehavior.after: Six current candidate-bound slices cover canonical evidence, identity, output validation, regression tests, review-path documentation, and agent authority; invalid evidence remains rejected.

correctionSummary: Expanded the canonical Architecture Reviewer evidence contract to preserve all material approved Brief obligations and accepted Planning identity/acceptance references, bound semantic reuse to all verdict-relevant normal-review context, and documented the distinct Factory self-review boundary. Reused the existing Phase 6 verifier for cg-12.
testsAdded: material approved Brief evidence references pass the ArchitectureReviewService output boundary
bounded context changes invalidate reuse while operational row versions remain non-semantic

targetedChecks.reproductionBeforeCorrection: Provider evidenceRefs for brief:contentRequirements were rejected as invented; canonical set size was 25 and seven required refs were missing.
